rationale: Agent-noun or qualitative on the same root as ⲡⲱⲁⲡⲧ 'the molding/fashioning' (already in glossary). Context (descent alone into the midst of all worlds of darkness, not loving them) corresponds to the cosmological descent of the First Man. May be a typological epithet identifying the First Man as the cosmic prototype of human-fashioning.

Discourse-typological marker introducing parallel applications, used twice on this page (lines 4, 7) in the structurally repeating formula 'ⲧⲥⲉ ⲁⲛ X' / 'ⲧⲥⲉ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲧⲛ̄Y.' Variant of ⲧⲛⲟ/ⲡⲛⲟ already in glossary as 'the manner.' Confirms a wider Lycopolitan family of manner-introducers.

proposed_english: to restore / to return (to original state)
rationale: Verbal compound used in line 15 'they shall ⲣ̄-ⲧⲥⲉ them where they were existing from the beginning.' Soteriological return-to-origin verb. Possibly cognate with ⲧⲥⲟ 'establish' or with a return/restoration root. Confidence low; awaits parallel attestations.

Modifier paired with ⲥⲁⲥⲉ 'bitter' in line 13 describing the Enemy who masters with violent teachings. Etymology unclear — possibly Lyc. ⲍⲥⲱⲭⲉ on ⲥⲱϣ 'scorn' or ϩⲱϫ 'oppress.' Functions as the affective complement to bitterness in the Enemy's character.

proposed_english: set in him / established in him
rationale: Spans line 11-12 break: 'his thought and the love of giving toward his men exists ⲛ̄ⲥⲏⲧϩ̄.' Likely qualitative ⲥⲏⲧ 'set, established' (from ⲥⲙⲛ̄/ⲥⲏⲧ stem) + 3sg.m. suffix -ϩ̄ (= -ϥ̄). Names the inward establishment of the Father's loving thought.

Confirms tentative glossary entry ⲡⲥⲉⲧ as 'fire' (Lyc. contraction of ⲥⲉⲧⲉ). Listed alongside ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲃ 'gold' as one of the elemental treasures of the cosmos (line 6). Element-as-treasure cosmological register.
